sections.heading: Rules of the road: first part — D
sections.markdown:
Accuracy handling for rules of the road: first part: every indexed statement keeps a single physical-page locator. The original chapter assembly and its per-chapter provenance remain pinned.
Text-supported reasonable-speed, priority, signal and sign-class rules are covered. Images on the speed table contain values absent from extracted text; those image-only values remain typed debt rather than learner facts. Unlabelled individual sign graphics and their visual recognition remain deferred. No image is reproduced and no visual-recognition coverage is claimed.
No issuer-current-edition confirmation is inferred from local registration. (verify) sec03-accuracy-currentness
